# API & UX Quality Checklist: Due Dates and Priority for Tasks

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of requirements for validation/400 responses, sort and filter behaviour, and keyboard accessibility
**Created**: 2026-11-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Validation & 400 Responses

- [ ] CHK001 Is "invalid priority" enumerated (unknown name, number, empty string, wrong type)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "invalid due date" defined (wrong format, impossible calendar date, date with time, out-of-range year)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the 400 error body shape specified (fields, naming the offending parameter), not just "a clear error message"? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are validation requirements defined for every input path: POST query, PUT body, and GET query parameters? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified that a request with both a valid and an invalid field changes nothing (no partial update)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the treatment of a null or empty-string `priority` in PUT and POST defined, and distinct from "omitted"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements consistent between API (case-insensitive priority, always returned canonical) and the chat agent and page inputs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the due-date format accepted by the API stated, and is it consistent with the scripted model's YYYY-MM-DD? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK009 Is validation behaviour for the page's inputs (date field, priority selector) specified, or are invalid states made impossible? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the precedence between 400 (invalid input) and 404 (unknown task id) defined when both apply? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the behaviour when the task title is missing or blank on create defined, given the new optional parameters? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Sort & Filter Behaviour

- [ ] CHK012 Is the default order fully specified as a total order, including the tie-break for identical priority, date and title? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Is title comparison defined (case sensitivity, culture)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the API's default order (when no sort is requested) stated, and is it consistent with the page and chat default order? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "due on or before" inclusivity consistent across the page, API and any wording such as "due before"? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified whether tasks with no due date are included or excluded by the due-date filter? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the overdue filter's interaction with completed tasks and with the due-date filter defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Are combined-filter semantics (AND) stated explicitly for both page and API? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the supported values of each query parameter (including boolean forms and the `sort` options) enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the empty-result experience on the page specified (message wording, ability to clear filters)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Is filter persistence defined (kept after add, edit, complete, delete; reset on reload)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the position of a task that no longer matches the order after an edit (moves immediately or on refresh) specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the behaviour at midnight (a task becoming overdue while the page is open) specified or explicitly excluded? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "most urgent incomplete task" objectively defined so SC-001 and SC-002 can be measured, including how the 5-second test is run? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]

## Keyboard Accessibility & UX

- [ ] CHK025 Are keyboard operability requirements defined for every new control (priority selector, date input, clear-date, filters, edit actions)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Is a logical tab and focus order specified for the add form, filters and task rows? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the overdue marker required to be conveyed by more than colour (text or icon), and available to screen readers? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK028 Are priority levels distinguishable without colour alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK029 Are accessible names/labels required for date and priority inputs and filter controls? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Is focus behaviour defined after a task is edited, re-sorted, deleted or after filters change (no focus loss)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK031 Are status changes (filter results updated, validation errors) required to be announced to assistive technology? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Is keyboard submission specified for adding a task (Enter) and for cancelling an inline edit (Escape)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the "Overdue" marker's visual prominence defined measurably rather than as "visibly marked"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK034 Are contrast and text-size expectations for badges and markers stated or referenced to a standard? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the chat suggested-prompt list's keyboard access and its growth in size (new examples added) addressed? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
